thread:
Maya: Quick preflight — we should lock priority for the new model bring-up this week. proposing a focused perf + quant preflight for `solace-9b`
Kai: +1. what's the minimal checklist?
Maya: Minimal: throughput sweep (batch sizes), single-request p50/p95 latency, ctx-length sweep (512, 1024, 2048, 4096), and an int8 quant smoke with quality sanity checks.
Sven: Also add warmup profile: cold start vs steady-state. we saw big deltas last time.
Anika: Agree. For quality smoke: run 3 eval sets — chat-fluency short, long-context consistency, and instruction-following. 100 samples each is fine for smoke.
Maya: Good. Acceptance gates: throughput within 20% of fp16 baseline OR quant fallback path; latency p95 under 1.5x baseline for 1k tokens; no >5% quality regression on any smoke set.
Kai: Resource ask: need 2 A100s (shared windows) for batching matrix. Can we book them? @InfraBot ?
InfraBot: infra-ticket-#8342 created: "bench slots request - solace-9b preflight". Proposed window: Thu 09:00-13:00 UTC.
Lucas: Thu works for me. I'll own the batching sweep and ctx-sweep harness.
Sven: I'll run the quantization smoke (int8 with llama.cpp-style path + Triton int8 path) and do an initial log compare.
Anika: I'll prepare the 3 eval packs and the small scoring script (BLEU-ish + answer-coherence heuristics).
Maya: Outline of commands (rough):
```
bench_run --model solace-9b --mode throughput --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8,16 --seq 1024 
bench_run --model solace-9b --mode latency --batch-size 1 --seq 1024 --measure p50,p95
bench_run --model solace-9b --mode ctx-sweep --seqs 512,1024,2048,4096 --batch 1,4
quant_smoke --model solace-9b --quant int8 --paths [triton,ggml] --eval small_smoke.json
```
Kai: For the batching matrix, please capture per-token throughput and allocator metrics (GPU mem usage, fragmentation). use `--trace allocator` if possible.
Maya: Good call. Also capture cold-start timings (first request 0 -> response) separately. label runs `cold` vs `steady`.
Sven: How do we record artifacts? prefer s3 prefix `s3://redwood-perf/solace-9b/preflight/<ts>/`
Lucas: I'll kick off an empty folder and add a README with run commands.
Anika: ETA on eval packs: EOD today.
Maya: Owners summary: Lucas (batch + ctx harness), Sven (quant smoke + logs), Anika (eval packs + scoring), Kai (pass/fail and run coordinator). I'll coordinate overall and post results in this thread.
Kai: timeline: Thu run, Fri morning triage + short sync (15m).
Maya: blockers?
Sven: Potential blocker: model checkpoint needs conversion to our runtime format; conversion script currently on my laptop. will push to repo by tonight.
Anika: Also need a seed list for reproducibility. I'll generate and check into the eval pack.
Maya: OK. If nothing else, we'll confirm infra window and I'll pin this thread. :thumbsup:
Kai: thanks — I'll @remind on Wed 09:00 to confirm infra.
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled for 1748950000 (Wed 09:00 UTC)
Maya: Thanks all — see you Thu.
